0022600199.text: The Dallas Mavericks (5-4, 10th in the West and 2 games back in the Southwest) host the Brooklyn Nets (2-6, 13th in the East) in Dallas's 10th game of the season, with the Mavericks on a W1 streak and 5-4 over their last ten. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Dallas swept Brooklyn 3-0 in 2025-26, and the Mavericks' most recent meeting was a 123-114 win in Brooklyn on February 24, 2026. Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation) are listed as out for Dallas, and Egor Demin (leg bruise) is listed as out for Brooklyn.
